summary: Correctly narrows the monotonicity check from all dims to only the concatenation dims (concat_dims), so identical non-varying non-monotonic coordinates no longer raise, matching the documented behavior. Minimal, targeted fix that resolves the issue.

issues.description: Old code guarded with `if dim in concatenated` before calling indexes.get; new loop over concat_dims calls indexes.get(dim) unconditionally. If a concat dim ever lacked an index, indexes.get returns None and .is_monotonic_increasing raises AttributeError. In practice combine_by_coords infers concat_dims from coordinates so they always have indexes, so risk is negligible.
